### func \(\*Buffer\) DecodeGraphemeAt

```go
func (b *Buffer) DecodeGraphemeAt(off int) (rune, []rune, int)
```

DecodeGraphemeAt returns the grapheme information at the given offset\, along with the size of the grapheme\. A grapheme consists of a rune\, and an arbitrary number of combining runes\, such as accents or other markings to be applied to the visualization of the rune\.

### func \(\*Buffer\) Modified

```go
func (b *Buffer) Modified() bool
```

Modified returns true if this buffer has been modified since loading\. If the file is small enough it will hash the buffer to compare to an initial hash\. If not it will use a boolean \(but this can give a false positive\)\.

### func \(\*Buffer\) Replace

```go
func (b *Buffer) Replace(re *regexp.Regexp, loc []int, repl []byte) int
```

Replace the match from loc with repl\. Before replacement\, 're\.Expand' is performed on the replacement slice\, which expands submatch identifiers like $1\. Use $$ for a literal dollar sign\. Returns the number of bytes inserted for replacement\.

### func \(\*Buffer\) ReplaceFunc

```go
func (b *Buffer) ReplaceFunc(loc []int, repl func([]byte) []byte) int
```

ReplaceFunc replaces the match from loc by passing the matched slice through a replacement function\. Expand is not performed\. Returns the number of bytes inserted for replacement\.

### func \(\*Buffer\) ReplaceLiteral

```go
func (b *Buffer) ReplaceLiteral(loc []int, repl []byte) int
```

ReplaceLiteral replaces the match from loc with 'repl'\. Expand is not performed\. Returns the number of bytes inserted for replacement\.

### func \(\*Buffer\) Save

```go
func (b *Buffer) Save() error
```

Save writes the contents of this buffer to the stored output\. If successful it resets the modification status and rehashes the file\, if possible\.

### func \(\*Buffer\) SetContent

```go
func (b *Buffer) SetContent(newb *text.Buffer)
```

SetContent modifies the content of this buffer so that it is equivalent to newb\. This is done by making a diff and applying edits so that undo history will be preserved across the arbitrary modification\. The input must be a text\.Buffer to ensure that the content being assigned is in the internal format\.

UnicodeLoc converts a unicode \(line\, col\) pair to byte position\, where col is the number of graphemes within the line\.
